tickerText: [TENNIS] Nitto ATP Finals Thursday in Turin pairs Ben Shelton with Rafael Jodar from 2 p.m. and Alexander Zverev with Arthur Fils at 8:30 p.m., with the World No. 1 already through after Carlos Alcaraz topped Daniil Medvedev 6-2, 6-4 and Frances Tiafoe beat Flavio Cobolli on Wednesday • [SQUASH] PSA China Open quarterfinals unfold in Shanghai with men's last-eight ties featuring Mostafa Asal, Youssef Ibrahim and Mohamad Zakaria, while Satomi Watanabe and Marina Stefanoni headline women's QF night sessions at Xian Xia • [BADMINTON] LI-NING Hong Kong Open round of 16 at Kai Tak Arena puts Loh Kean Yew through after 12-21, 21-9, 21-14 over Kenta Nishimoto, with Lakshya Sen set for Rasmus Gemke as Race to Finals spots tighten • [PICKLEBALL] Proton Daytona Beach Open moves to round of 16 Thursday at Pictona with PickleballTV from noon ET, overflow parking on Ridgewood Ave after local flooding, and John Lucian Goins chasing a third straight men's singles title • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Star Contender Muscat's main draw rolls on at Sultan Qaboos Sports Complex as 200-plus players from 37 nations contest singles and doubles toward a $300,000 purse led by Dang Qiu, Satsuki Odo and Darko Jorgic

newsItems.title: Turin Decision Day
newsItems.excerpt: Thursday at the Nitto ATP Finals sends Ben Shelton against Rafael Jodar and Alexander Zverev against Arthur Fils in the Boris Becker Group, with both semifinal places at stake after Alcaraz beat Medvedev and Tiafoe ousted Cobolli on Wednesday.

newsItems.title: Hong Kong Last 16
newsItems.excerpt: The LI-NING Hong Kong Open's round of 16 at Kai Tak delivers early winners including Tomoka Miyazaki and top-10 duo Pearly Tan and Thinaah Muralitharan, while Lakshya Sen's clash with Rasmus Gemke carries extra weight after he clinched a BWF Finals berth.

newsItems.title: Daytona Last 16
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA's Proton Daytona Beach Open advances to round of 16 Thursday at Holly Hill, with national PickleballTV coverage and overflow shuttle parking after flooding trimmed on-site options, in a men's singles draw reshaped by Christopher Haworth's round-of-32 exit.

newsItems.title: Muscat Star Contender
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Star Contender Muscat continues its main-draw week in Oman with top talents such as Dang Qiu, Satsuki Odo and Darko Jorgic chasing ranking points across five events at Sultan Qaboos Sports Complex through Nov. 21.
